title: Fair Enough: Searching for Sufficient Measures of Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It evaluates and clusters 30 different fairness metrics for machine learning classification tasks using datasets with protected attributes like sex, race, and age.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a part of the study.
